title: Remain trailer: Jake Gyllenhaal, Phoebe Dynevor battle paranormal forces
excerpt: Blending emotional drama with supernatural suspense, the latest trailer for director Manoj N Shyamlan's Remain offers a tantalising glimpse into a love story caught in the grip of dark forces.
content:
The official trailer and poster for the supernatural romantic thriller Remain, featuring actors Jake Gyllenhaal and Phoebe Dynevor has been unveiled. The Manoj N Shyamlan directorial is his collaboration with best-selling author Nicholas Sparks. The upcoming film is based on an original story co-written by Shyamalan and Sparks.

Building on the earlier teaser that introduced the connection between Tate Gordon (Gyllenhaal) and a mysterious young woman (Dynevor), the new trailer offers a closer look at the dark forces threatening to keep them apart. What begins as a conventional romance quickly takes an unsettling turn as their bond deepens.

The plot follows Tate as he moves into a new house, only to find a woman already living there who refuses to leave. While their daytime interactions spark romance, nightfall brings terror — the very woman Tate adores turns violent and sinister after sunset. Adding to the mystery, a strange bathroom appears to transform Dynevor's character into someone else entirely once darkness falls.

Cutting back and forth between their budding romance and eerie gothic visuals, the promo shows Dynevor’s character seemingly becoming possessed, leaving Tate torn between love and fear.

The screenplay of Remain has also been written by Shyamlan. Apart from Gyllenhaal and Dynevor, the film also features actors Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty, and Jay O Sanders in key roles. The upcoming romance based on paranormal elements is co-produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock, and Theresa Park, with Sparks serving as executive producer.

The technical crew includes cinematographer Adolpho Veloso, production designer Sam Lisenco, editor Nomi Preiswerk, costume designer Caroline Duncan, casting director Douglas Aibel, music supervisor Gabe Hilfer, and composer James Newton Howard.

Presented by Warner Bros Pictures and Blinding Edge Pictures, Remain is scheduled to release in Indian theatres in English on February 5, 2027, ahead of Valentine's Day.

Meanwhile, Gyllenhaal was last seen in the gothic romance film, The Bride (2026), written and directed by his sister, actor Maggie Gyllenhaal.

Dynevor, who steps into the supernatural world, is best known for portraying Daphne Bridgerton in Netflix’s hit series Bridgerton.
